images.description:
immature fruit in June
a modern eater that is a Golden Delicious crossed with a Danish apple called Ingrid Marie (which is a daughter of Cox's Orange pippin)
This is on a tiny tree, on M27 very dwarfing rootstock. I planted this as a pot grown tree in March 2023. It produced some apples last year and I liked them. It is quite a soft apple, so some folk wont like it, but a nice honeyed flavour.  
It got battered quite a bit during the patio work this winter but looks like it has come through that ok and I will now try to give it a bit of peace in coming years. 
Ash - Starcrossed
